# Create Alliance

**Version 1.2** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2237350746) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=create-alliance&expanded=true)

An alliance with anyone, anywhere, right now.

Vanilla makes you earn an alliance. You need a reason, usually a marriage or a
blood tie, you need them to like the odds, and they can still say no. This mod
skips all of it. Right-click, click once, done.

And since the base game grew its own negotiated alliance interaction, this one
has leaned into the things vanilla still will not do.

---

## Create Alliance

1. Right-click anyone at all.
1. Choose **Create Alliance** under diplomacy.
1. You are allied.

- **No negotiation.** No acceptance roll, no opinion check, no dynastic
  excuse required.
- **No distance limit.** Ally a ruler on the far side of the map you have
  never met.
- **No land required.** Courtiers, claimants, wandering nobles and landless
  adventurers are all fair game.
- **No cost.** No gold, no prestige, no hooks, no favours.

The alliance is a genuine one, not a fake. It is created through the game's own
alliance system and held together by the same bond vanilla uses for alliances
negotiated through the Diplomacy lifestyle, so calling allies to war and
everything else behaves normally.

**On allying the landless:** the game's rule for whether an alliance holds
has never cared about land — it only asks that some bond exists between you.
The bond this mod creates is one the game recognises, so an alliance with a
wandering adventurer is as durable as one with an emperor. If you play Roads to
Power, this is the feature to know about.

## Inherit Their Alliances

Every ally of the character you pick becomes your ally too, in a single click.

Find the best connected ruler on the map and adopt their entire diplomatic web.
Or ally one member of a coalition and quietly absorb the rest of it.

## Isolate Them

Strips a character of every alliance they have and leaves them standing alone.

The obvious use is the one you are already thinking of: pull the props out from
under a rival the moment before you declare war.

## Remove Alliance

Dissolves your alliance with one particular character, as always.

## Things to know

- **The AI never uses any of this.** It is a player tool only, so the
  diplomatic landscape around you behaves normally unless you reach into it.
- **Everything is reversible.** Alliances you make can be broken and
  alliances you break can be remade.

## Compatibility

- Built and tested against **CK3 1.19 "Scribe"**.
- **Ironman and achievements:** this mod will disable achievements, as
  gameplay mods do.
- **Other mods:** it adds four interactions and overwrites no base game
  file, so it should sit alongside almost anything.
- **Existing saves:** safe to add or remove mid-game. Alliances made with it
  are ordinary alliances and survive the mod being removed.
- The base game's own negotiated alliance interaction still works. This one
  sits beside it rather than replacing it.

## Languages

Available in all nine languages the game supports. English is fully written, and
the German translation is by **RHSoldat**. The two new interactions added in
1.2 are still in English everywhere else, and are marked in the files so they
are easy to find. Translations are very welcome.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `create-alliance-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=create-alliance&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
